mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PUSH_TOKEN ( PUSH_TOKEN , USR_ID , PLATFORM , USE_YN , FRST_REG_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{token} , #{usrId} , #{platform} , 'Y' , #{usrId} ) ON CONFLICT (PUSH_TOKEN) DO UPDATE SET USR_ID = EXCLUDED.USR_ID , PLATFORM = EXCLUDED.PLATFORM , USE_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MOD_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.USR_ID , LAST_MOD_DTM = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
mapper.select: SELECT PUSH_TOKEN FROM TB_PUSH_TOKEN WHERE USR_ID = #{usrId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
